verdict.rationale: Stagehand is an automation SDK, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no first-party capability for this. Caching, deterministic-script conversion, and Browserbase session replay are adjacent features: replay lets you review a past run, not compare or restore versions of an automation. Any versioning would come from the user's own source control, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
